questions.q: What are the four tabs available when filtering a discrete dimension in Tableau?
options: General, Wildcard, Condition, and Top
Sum, Average, Median, and Count
Relative Date, Range of Dates, Years, and Quarters
Include, Exclude, Fixed, and Table Calc
questions.explain: A dimension filter dialog offers General (manual selection), Wildcard (text matching), Condition (formula-based), and Top (top/bottom N) tabs.

questions.q: Why does Tableau ask you to choose an aggregation before filtering on a measure like Sales?
options: A measure like Sales has thousands of individual values behind it — 'filter where Sales > $500' is meaningless until you specify sum, average, or another aggregation
Measures cannot be filtered in Tableau at all
It's a random extra step with no functional purpose
Only dimensions can be aggregated, not measures
questions.explain: A measure represents many underlying rows, so Tableau must know whether 'Sales > $500' means the sum, average, or some other aggregation of those rows before it can filter.

questions.q: What's the practical difference between a Relative Date filter and a Range of Dates filter?
options: A Relative Date filter recalculates from 'today' every time the view is opened (e.g. 'last 30 days'); a Range of Dates filter stays fixed to the exact dates chosen
They produce identical results in every case
Range of Dates filters only work on dimensions, not dates
Relative Date filters can only be used with measures
questions.explain: Relative Date filters shift with the current date automatically, which is usually what a live, recurring dashboard needs; Range of Dates filters stay pinned to specific fixed dates.

questions.q: Which dimension filter tab would you use to keep only sub-categories where SUM([Profit]) is negative?
options: Condition
Wildcard
Top
General
questions.explain: The Condition tab keeps values where a formula evaluates true — exactly the case for a rule like SUM([Profit]) < 0.

questions.q: Which dimension filter tab does the Top N filter (covered in depth next lesson) actually live under?
options: Top
General
Wildcard
Condition
questions.explain: Top N filtering is one of the four tabs on the standard dimension filter dialog, alongside General, Wildcard, and Condition.
